productOnPage.title: BrainBots: Sports [US]
productOnPage.author: Yoto
productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Join the BrainBots as they discover the stories behind some of the world's most famous sports… and the crowd goes wild! Meet the BrainBots: Nellie, Buzz, and Gibbs! When school closes, these high-tech knowledge-gathering robots come to life to find out as much information as they can for kids before the next school day starts. They can do some amazing stuff, too - think travelling back in time, shrinking all the way down to explore tiny spaces, and going where humans can’t...In this series, the BrainBots, Nellie, Buzz and Gibbs, are learning all about sports. They’re sprinting back in time to find out how it all started, witnessing some of the most famous sporting moments in history, and even giving them a go themselves.This collection includes:BasketballTennisGolfFigure SkatingLacrosseBaseballAmerican FootballSoccer These audio cards will take you on fun fact-filled adventures to learn about different sports. Test your knowledge at the end of the card to see how many BrainBank facts you can remember! Tracks included: Chapter 1 Chapter 2 Chapter 3 Chapter 4 Chapter 5
productOnPage.descriptionHtml:
Meet the BrainBots: Nellie, Buzz, and Gibbs! When school closes, these high-tech knowledge-gathering robots come to life to find out as much information as they can for kids before the next school day starts. They can do some amazing stuff, too - think travelling back in time, shrinking all the way down to explore tiny spaces, and going where humans can’t...


In this series, the BrainBots, Nellie, Buzz and Gibbs, are learning all about sports. They’re sprinting back in time to find out how it all started, witnessing some of the most famous sporting moments in history, and even giving them a go themselves.


This collection includes:


  • Basketball
  • Tennis
  • Golf
  • Figure Skating
  • Lacrosse
  • Baseball
  • American Football
  • Soccer

 

These audio cards will take you on fun fact-filled adventures to learn about different sports. Test your knowledge at the end of the card to see how many BrainBank facts you can remember!
